authoritativeText.text:
1．
我们已经证明：经过任意一点至少可以引一条直线，与已知的直线平行．
实际上这样的直线有多少条呢？

我们知道：它不少于一条．
我们不加证明就承认以下的命题．

41 平行公理．
经过一点至多可以引一条直线与已知直线平行．

推论 1．
如果一条直线与两条平行直线中的一条直线相交，那么它与另一条直线也相交．

证明．
设 $a\parallel b$，$c\cap a=A$（图 204）．
如果直线 $c$ 与 $b$ 不相交，那么，经过点 $A$ 有两条直线（$a$ 和 $c$）与直线 $b$ 平行．

这与平行公理相矛盾．
就是说，直线$c$与$b$相交．
■

semanticMapping.sourceInterpretation: The printed finite gap is part of the source drawing. It is not the proposition that the entire straight line c never meets b. The complete proof assumes a parallel b and c intersecting a at A, temporarily supposes c does not meet b, rejects that supposition by the parallel axiom, and concludes that c meets b.
premises: A belongs to a and c
a and c are distinct crossing lines
semanticMapping.refutedSupposition: c does not meet b; equivalently c parallel b in this proof
executableClaims: Original a/b directions realize the proof premise a parallel b.
Original c endpoints remain fixed; the solid c stroke still ends above b.
Modern dashed continuation is collinear with original c.
Modern endpoint (6295/13,45) belongs to the underlying c and to b; hence c/b intersection is exhibited without a new point label.

derivation.onModernSegment: x increases from 415 to 6295/13 while y decreases from 105 to 45

modernAdditions.visualSeparation: Dashed muted stroke; all source strokes stay solid ink.
modernAdditions.justification: An explicit depiction of the conclusion already present in the authoritative proof. It does not invent a new given or reveal an exercise answer.
modernAdditions.scope: Only the existing solid c endpoint to its justified b intersection.

notExecutableOrAsserted: A false assertion that the original finite stroke already meets b

resolvedFirstUnknowns.a_b_parallel: Authoritative premise, realized by the unchanged horizontal source representatives.
resolvedFirstUnknowns.c_b_nonintersection: Temporary supposition, explicitly refuted; not an actual fact.
resolvedFirstUnknowns.c_extrapolation: Permitted as an explicitly separate modern addition justified by the proved conclusion.
resolvedFirstUnknowns.A_marker: Preserve source label without adding a source dot; no separately reliable source dot was observed.
